post.summary: Create a Mono link session (returns Mono Connect URL for frontend/mobile)
post.description: Create a pending hosted-link session. Customer and meta.ref come from the server. Redirect aliases must agree and match the configured allowlist. Hosted completion uses webhooks, not a guaranteed redirect code. Mobile clients must explicitly send trackiq://mono/callback configured as MONO_MOBILE_REDIRECT_URL. MONO_WEB_REDIRECT_URL separately configures a served HTTPS frontend callback. Redirects must exactly match configuration and are never rewritten. The old TrackFund mobile scheme is rejected. HTTPS callbacks require a qualified hostname, no doubled path separators, and no query or fragment; https://trackfund//mono/callback is rejected even if configured. Mobile clients must intercept return navigation to scheme trackiq, host mono, path /callback, allowing provider-added query parameters such as status=linked&reason=account_linked. Prevent loading that URL, close the webview once, then poll GET /api/mono/link-session/{reference} with the saved reference and refresh accounts when connection is confirmed. A redirect alone does not prove connection; transaction sync must not keep the webview open. Reconcile the saved reference on manual close or app resume too. After correcting callback settings, create a fresh session instead of reusing an old hosted link.

redirect_url.description: Exact allowed callback base URL passed to Mono unchanged. Mobile: trackiq://mono/callback. Web: HTTPS with a qualified hostname and no doubled path separators. Do not include query parameters or fragments here; provider-added query parameters on return navigation must be handled by the mobile app.

post.summary: Upload and replace the signed-in user avatar
post.description: Exactly one multipart file field, maximum 5 MiB. JPEG, PNG and WebP are decoded and converted to a square 512x512 PNG with metadata removed. Maximum 12 megapixels and 8192 pixels per dimension. Ten uploads/hour/user. A unique durable HTTPS URL is committed to the same profile returned by GET /api/profile/me. Prior managed objects are deleted asynchronously after commit. Storage must be configured.

delete.description: Atomically hides the link and schedules a durable Mono unlink job. Imported transactions are retained internally for audit but hidden from all app reads. Delayed webhooks and sync jobs cannot restore or import into a removed link. Repeat deletion by the same owner returns 204. Missing or foreign IDs return 404. Provider unlink retries in the background; a fresh Mono authorization is required to reconnect.
